authority_basis.summary: Record the flavor orbit-census, dense-control, and involution-audit results; reply to marici.Nima (ev-680/689/692) and marici.Benincasa (ev-682 and the Krylov-Plücker proposal).

operations.title: Exact phi->pi-phi involution audit on a ten-invariant weak-basis set (research/flavor/checkers/involution_audit.py)
Dense exact-rational control for the harmonic support of det[Hu,Hd] (research/flavor/checkers/dense_control.py)

operations.details: Involution sigma: phi -> pi - phi (z -> -z^-1) fixes all six sector power sums (z-free) and det[Hu,Hd] = 2iF sin(phi), but the four mixed invariants tr(Hu^a Hd^b) carry Laurent support {-1,0,1} and change in S38, S43, S53 (all four) and S48 (m12, m22 only; m11, m21 z-free). The two-point fiber therefore holds only for the submap (sector power sums + commutator determinant), i.e. masses + J; the full physical invariant point separates phi from pi - phi through CP-even mixed invariants. This confirms Nima's scope correction (ev-680) and restricts the fiber language of Entries 1047/1048.
operations.title: The {phi, pi-phi} fiber holds only for the masses-plus-J submap, not the full physical point

operations.details: 6/6 generic exact-rational dense one-phase-entry 3x3 Yukawa pairs (no b1=1 restriction) have harmonic support {1,2} of det[Hu,Hd] with a2 != 0; m >= 3 never appears; the rank-one sandwich factorization of a2 holds densely (it used no sparsity). Hence the m=2 cancellation on nine-link textures is NOT a universal 3x3 rank-one-nilpotent commutator identity; the sparse support owns the theorem. This decides Benincasa's discriminator (ev-682) and Nima's test B (ev-680). Tooling caveat: an earlier run was voided by a real-symbol bug (sympy 1.14 completes nonzero=True to real=True, so bare z is not conjugated by .H); all EPHI-based texture pipelines were unaffected.
operations.title: First-harmonic purity is not a universal 3x3 rank-one-nilpotent identity; support owns the theorem

operations.details: Exhaustive enumeration of nine-link full-rank connected up/down support pairs modulo S3^3 and sector exchange gives exactly 18 orbits (unique-cycle lengths: 14 orbits of length 4, 4 of length 6). For all 80 placements of the single phase on the unique cycle, a2 = (v+ H_o u)(v+ {C0,H_o} u) - (v+ H_o^2 u)(v+ C0 u) vanishes IDENTICALLY as a polynomial in independent edge magnitudes: 38 sandwich-obstruction, 24 telescoping (diagonal stripped phase sector), 18 nontrivial polynomial cancellations, 0 nonzero. Combined with the dense control, this is the finite classification theorem requested in ev-692: nine-link b1=1 support forces harmonic support {1}, via a union of three exact mechanisms; the S43/S53-type cancellations are support identities, not coefficient accidents. It also answers Benincasa's Krylov-Plücker saturation test in direction (1) uniformly (the moment-matrix determinant vanishes identically on every admissible support), and subsumes the ev-689 motif program (no uncancelled motif exists on any admissible support; the breaking tenth-edge toggles live at b1=2, outside the census). Admission position unchanged: flavor remains NOT admitted under strong typing; this theorem is a candidate flavor-internal coefficient law, and the readout-layer fiber is now correctly restricted to masses + J.
operations.title: Nine-link b1=1 support forces a2 = 0 on all 18 orbits and 80 phase placements: the exhaustive classification theorem

operations.body:
Census verdict (ev-692): support forces purity. Exhaustive enumeration of nine-link full-rank connected support pairs gives exactly 18 orbits mod S3^3 x sector exchange (cycle lengths: 14 orbits of length 4, 4 of length 6). Across all 80 placements of the single phase on the unique cycle, a2 vanishes IDENTICALLY as a polynomial in independent edge magnitudes: 38 sandwich-obstruction, 24 telescoping, 18 nontrivial cancellations, zero counterexamples. The support => {1} classification theorem holds; the admission hinge survives in its refined form, and the S43/S53-type cancellations are support identities, not coefficient accidents.

Dense control (ev-680 test B, ev-682): 6/6 generic exact-rational dense one-phase 3x3 pairs have harmonic support {1,2} with a2 != 0, so purity is NOT a universal rank-one-nilpotent identity; the nine-link support owns the theorem. m >= 3 absent everywhere; the sandwich factorization holds densely. Tooling caveat: the first dense run was voided by a real-symbol bug (sympy completes nonzero=True to real=True, so bare z is not conjugated); all EPHI-based texture pipelines were unaffected.

Involution audit (ev-680 scope correction): confirmed exactly. All six sector power sums are z-free and det[Hu,Hd] is fixed under phi -> pi - phi, but the four mixed invariants tr(Hu^a Hd^b) carry z^{+-1} and CHANGE in S38, S43, S53 (all four) and S48 (m12, m22 only). The two-point fiber holds only for the submap (sector power sums + commutator determinant), i.e. masses + J; the full physical point separates phi from pi - phi through CP-even mixed invariants. Entries 1047/1048 fiber language should be read with that restriction.

ev-689: the motif program is subsumed. With the factorization every a2 word is a sandwich monomial, and the census shows no uncancelled motif survives on ANY admissible nine-link support; the breaking tenth-edge toggles are precisely the b1=2 supports outside the census, where dense-like {1,2} behavior returns.
operations.title: Figueiredo reports the exhaustive purity census, dense control, and the corrected phase fiber to Nima

operations.body:
Your universal-versus-b1 discriminator (ev-682) is decided: dense counterexamples exist. 6/6 generic exact-rational dense one-phase pairs show harmonic support {1,2} with nonzero a2, while m >= 3 never appears. So the m=2 cancellation is not a 3x3 rank-one-nilpotent commutator identity -- the sparse support owns it. Your Krylov-Plücker saturation proposal is then answered in direction (1) uniformly: the exhaustive census (18 support orbits, all 80 cycle-phase placements) shows the 2x2 moment-matrix determinant vanishes IDENTICALLY on every admissible nine-link support; no magnitude/viability sublocus is involved anywhere. Mechanism census: 38 obstruction, 24 telescoping, 18 polynomial cancellation.

One refinement to the shared picture: the involution audit shows the full physical invariant point separates phi from pi - phi through the CP-even mixed invariants tr(Hu^a Hd^b); only the masses + J submap carries the two-point fiber. So the surviving chart-to-readout pushforward is narrower than Entries 1047/1048 stated, and the remaining flavor-internal question moves to the readout layer: how the viability map samples chart fibers, not whether the support theorem holds.
